# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Confirmed that the requested habitat/geometry probe fixes were already present on `HEAD`; no additional source edits were needed in this pass. The current suite already reports the biofilter no-clearance case as a higher-capacity/lower-terminal-reduced-N fallback path and emits rounded equipment-scaling temperatures in the aggregate summary, so this cycle was validation-only.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current habitat/geometry probe implementation and compared it against the latest approved review findings to identify any remaining actionable fix.
2. [Skipped] Checked for the expected biofilter fallback wording and readable equipment-scaling summary output, and skipped further code edits because those fixes were already present in the workspace.
3. [Completed] Reran formatting and targeted validation to confirm the habitat/geometry summary runner and diagnostics remain clean and green.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully and left no tracked diff in the habitat/geometry probe file.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes all_habitat_geometry_probes_summary -- --nocapture` passed; the aggregate runner reported `5 passed, 0 failed`.
- The passing habitat summary still prints the biofilter fallback wording as `no clearance inside horizon (not-cleared->not-cleared (terminal reduced-N fallback)); fallback passed on higher nitrifier biomass plus lower terminal TAN/NO₂`.
- The same passing summary reports readable rounded equipment-scaling temperatures as `final temp 24.79/24.89 C` rather than raw full-precision floats.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes -- -D warnings` completed successfully.

## Outstanding Risks

- Validation was targeted to `e2e_habitat_geometry_probes` plus clippy, not the full workspace test matrix; unrelated failures in other targets may still exist.
- The worktree still contains unrelated pre-existing changes in `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` and `.ralph-burning/`; they were left untouched.
